نحتش (form VIII)
# نَحْتَشِ (naḥtaši) /naħ.ta.ʃi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# نُحْتَشَ (nuḥtaša) /nuħ.ta.ʃa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
